questions.q: The default Betaflight 2025.12 profile (the same as in 4.5): `rates_type = ACTUAL`, `roll_rc_rate = 7`, `roll_srate = 67`, `roll_expo = 0`. What does this mean for roll?
options: A center of 70 °/s per full travel, a maximum of 670 °/s
RC rate 0.07, super rate 0.67, a maximum of about 42 °/s
A center of 14 °/s, a maximum of 670 °/s
A center of 70 °/s, a maximum of 1998 °/s limited by rate_limit
questions.explain: In Actual `rc_rate`×10 is the sensitivity at the center and `srate`×10 is the maximum rate (`applyActualRates`, fc/rc.c). The 0.07/0.67 option is the same three numbers read with the Betaflight model.

questions.q: In the BETAFLIGHT model `roll_expo = 50` was set without touching RC rate and super rate. What will change?
options: The maximum will drop, the center will stay the same
The center will become twice as soft, the maximum will not change
The center and the maximum will not change, only the middle will shift
The center and the maximum will grow by half
questions.explain: x' = x·|x|³·e + x·(1−e): as x→0 the slope is multiplied by (1−e) = 0.5, and at x = 1 x' = 1, so the maximum 200·r/(1−s) is kept. A shift of the middle only is expo in Actual.

questions.q: ELRS 500 Hz, `rc_smoothing_auto_factor = 30`, all `rc_smoothing_*_cutoff = 0`. What cutoff will the “Active setpoint and FF cutoff” line of `rc_smoothing_info` show (2025.12)?
options: 500 Hz — the cutoff equals the packet rate
15 Hz — the minimum cutoff
187 Hz
250 Hz — half of the packet rate
questions.explain: cutoff = max(15, f_rx·1.5/(1 + 30/10)) = 500·0.375 = 187.5, stored as an integer → 187 Hz (`rcSmoothingSetFilterCutoffs`). 15 Hz is the lower bound, and it applies only on slow links. In 4.5 the formula is the same, but the setpoint cutoff and the FF cutoff were printed on separate lines.

questions.q: Which `rc_smoothing_info` output points to a link problem on ELRS 250 Hz?
questions.fragment:
# Detected Rx frequency: 148Hz
# RC Smoothing: ON
# Active setpoint and FF cutoff: 55Hz (auto)
# Active throttle cutoff: 55Hz (auto)
options: Everything is fine: the 55 Hz cutoff corresponds to factor 30 and the measured link rate
The cutoffs are manual, the auto mode is off
Smoothing is off, `rc_smoothing = ON` is needed
148 Hz was measured instead of 250: packets are being lost, or the radio is in a different mode
questions.explain: The 55 Hz cutoff is honestly computed from 148 Hz (⌊148·0.375⌋), but the rate itself is 40 % below the configured packet rate. The “(auto)” lines and “RC Smoothing: ON” say that the auto mode and smoothing are on (the 2025.12 format; in 4.5 the first line is “RC Smoothing Type: FILTER”, and the FF cutoff is on a separate line).

questions.q: A radio with ELRS: the stick at the stop gives 2012 µs, `rxrange` is at the default. What happens?
options: The channel goes beyond rx_max_usec, and after 300 ms it gets the rxfail value
The full rate is reached at 2000 µs, and the last ~2 % of travel are dead
The rate at the stop exceeds the profile maximum by 2.4 %
Nothing: Betaflight calibrates ELRS by itself
questions.explain: `rcCommand` is limited to ±500, so everything above 2000 is cut off. The validity window 885…2115 is not violated. The fix is `rxrange <ch> 988 2012`.

questions.q: A pilot moved from ELRS 150 Hz to 500 Hz, and FF in Blackbox turned into “grass” with almost still sticks. What do the 4.3 notes advise for 500 Hz?
options: `feedforward_smooth_factor` 65–70 and `feedforward_averaging = 2_POINT`
`feedforward_boost` 40 and `feedforward_transition` 0
`rc_smoothing = OFF`, so that FF does not lag
`feedforward_jitter_factor = 0` and `feedforward_averaging = OFF` for less delay
questions.explain: In 4.5 FF smoothing was applied per packet: at 500 Hz the default coefficient of 25 smoothed almost nothing. In 2025.12 the values 65 and 2_POINT became the defaults, and the smooth scale is normalized to 250 Hz. Disabling the jitter filter and the smoothing would only increase the noise.

questions.q: Betaflight 2025.12: `thr_mid = 40`, `thr_hover = 40`, `thr_expo = 0`. How will the throttle curve change compared with the defaults 50 / 50 / 0?
options: The hover throttle will shift to 40 % of travel
The curve will become steeper below 40 % of travel and flatter above 40 %
It will not: with thr_expo = 0 and thr_mid = thr_hover the curve is a straight line
The throttle will be limited to 40 % at the top
questions.explain: In 2025.12 the curve is two Bezier segments through the point (thr_mid, thr_hover). With expo = 0 these are the straight lines (0,0) → (40,40) → (100,100), that is, a single straight line. If thr_hover had stayed at 50, the curve would have become steeper below 40 % and flatter above. In 4.5 there is no thr_hover variable, and with expo = 0 thr_mid had no effect at all. A limit at the top is `throttle_limit_*`.

questions.q: Rate profiles have to be switched from a switch in flight. What is true for Betaflight 2025.12?
options: A RATE PROFILE mode is needed in the Modes tab
With `rate_6pos_switch = ON` six different profiles are available
The same switch also changes the PID profile
`adjrange` with function 12; 3 positions → profiles 0–2
questions.explain: RATE_PROFILE is Adjustments function number 12, and there is no mode for it in Modes. There are four rate profiles, so positions 5–6 with `rate_6pos_switch` lead nowhere. The PID profile is not switched through Adjustments (neither in 4.5 nor in 2025.12).
